g.text: NGC API Key (or set NGC_API_KEY env var)
Git Token (optional; only needed for private forks)
Images will be built locally from nv-config-manager ref 'main'; registry pulls are disabled for AIR demos.
Cumulus Version Override (leave blank to use topology values)
Disable aggressive DHCP tuning on Cumulus switches
Skip reset of Cumulus nodes before DHCP refresh
